svg.text: Canton terrain • revise the plan around the implementation
2026-09-29 | Original Day 01–20 IDs retained | One 200 × 200 m district, not a completed city
BEFORE: creation-first daily instructions
Terrain import, district layout and paint setup
were still scheduled as new work.
Generic deliverable paths obscured saved maps.
Provisional handoff could be read as completion.
External source delays had no honest finish date.
AFTER: baseline + remaining work for every day
Reuse saved WP maps and validated R16 pipeline.
Keep historical XY/Z blocked and explicit.
Close threshold, pawn, art and runtime gaps.
Synchronize master and all 20 daily plans.
Re-estimate effort; no automatic 20-day promise.
Continuation order on the existing district
1 Owner / target / clearance decisions → 2 Closed-gate threshold + pawn + collision
3 Final paving / transitions / foliage / debris → 4 Development runtime + WP capture
H1/H2/Z source work continues alongside this; accepted evidence triggers a versioned migration.
Historical guard • no promotion from plausibility
H1: ≥5 fit, ≥8 checks; RMSE ≤15 m / max ≤30 m.
H2: ≥4 local checks; ≤2 m / ≤4 m (or stricter).
Z: dated walking surface + benchmark + datum.
Owner approval remains pending.
Modern DTM and diagnostic bounds remain D.
Technical guard • evidence must match the claim
7 route screens ≠ a physical pawn walk.
6 m staging ≠ accessible gate threshold.
Growth cubes / damp cards ≠ completed M04.
Editor timings ≠ Development performance.
Targeted cook ≠ normal project packaging.
Validation for this documentation revision
Check 20 synchronized daily sections, links, issue references and SVG structure; git diff --check.
Refresh affected manifest chain; run source, encoding, import, readiness, district, runner and freeze checks.
No UE assets changed; prior native evidence retained. Runtime and historical gates are still open.
